errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the chart has two Y-axes with different scales (a left axis from 15% to 45% and a right axis from 45% to 65%). This is a critical structural feature of the plot.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с процентни стойности – от 15% до 65%. Скалата е линейна, диапазонът е от 15% до 65%, а етикетите са разположени на равномерни интервали от 5%, започвайки от 15% и завършвайки на 65%.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the two Y-axes into a single axis. The left Y-axis ranges from 15% to 45% with 10% intervals, while the right Y-axis ranges from 45% to 65% with 4% intervals. The stated range and interval of 5% are incorrect for both.
The blue line, representing 'потребителски стоки', ends at approximately 25% in 2017, not 28%.

errors.text_span: след което има плавно нарастване до 2017 година
errors.evidence: The description of the blue line's trend is incorrect. After 2013, the line increases until 2016 and then shows a visible decrease in 2017. It does not increase all the way to 2017.

errors.text_span: след което има лек спад до 2017 година
errors.evidence: The description of the red line is incorrect. The line shows a continuous increase from 2012 to 2017. There is no drop in 2017.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от точката (2008, 41%) и завършва в точката (2017, 48%).
errors.evidence: The values provided for the green line are completely incorrect. Reading from the left axis, the line starts at ~39% and ends at ~23%. The reported values of 41% and 48% do not correspond to the data on either Y-axis.

errors.text_span: Тя показва спад от 41% през 2008 г. до 27% през 2011 г., последван от нарастване до 36% през 2012 г., след което има рязък спад до 2013 г. и отново плавно нараства до 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for the green line is almost entirely incorrect. In reality, the line drops from 2008 to 2009, rises to a peak in 2011, and then shows a long, steep decline until 2016, followed by a small increase in 2017. The description misidentifies peaks as troughs, reports increases as drops, and vice versa, with incorrect values throughout.
